capture_window.note: Collecting root reported acquisition after the first clock reading and completion before the final clock reading. Exact start/end and individual Copy/menu times were not supplied.

reference: GTO Wizard existing solved library, manually observed by collecting root
ui_provenance: Root reported the visible UI and Copy acquisition; this file's writer did not operate the browser. Raw UI/screenshot archives were not supplied to the writer.
url_provenance: Directly captured common base URL plus the root row history_spot=12 from menus.json; river_actions was absent. Parameter values are retained, original URL parameter order is not.
preflop: UTG raise to 2; HJ fold; CO fold; BTN call; SB fold; BB raise to 14; UTG fold; BTN call

folded_seat_context.note: The squeeze history and starting pot are retained. A simple two-seat open-call game is not substituted; compatibility arithmetic below does not certify folded-seat effects.

root_ranges.weights: Copy original text, unrenormalized, with exactly one final LF appended by collecting root

copy_freshness.rejected_attempt: Initial Playwright getByText('Copy').click left old HU-R0-019 clipboard content unchanged; it was detected and not adopted as HU-R0-022 data.
copy_freshness.oop: Clipboard sentinel r1-022-oop-copy-pending, native Copy click, explicit Whole range selection, then new 2347-character content.
copy_freshness.ip: Native right-side BTN Copy, copied toast, and different new 1363-character content.
copy_freshness.scope: Acquisition actions are the collecting root's report. File verification independently confirms supplied length/FNV and retained SHA-256, not browser semantics or export completeness.

observed_menus.scope: Root menu only; later decision menus are not inferred from these sizes.

continuation_menu_record.note: All 72 decision menus were visited and only then deduplicated to 18 action lists. Closure is independently checked; Fold/Call/second Check are derived terminal edges, not terminal UI or settlement observations.

root_ui.view: Root UI as reported by collecting root
root_ui.note: Displayed zero frequencies are not certified exact-zero strategies. EV/equity displays are rounded observations, not independent residuals or an identified EV-origin contract.

rake_evidence.catalog_description: General NL50, 5% cap 4bb from the R0 library Rake-help observation
rake_evidence.note: Do not infer actual terminal rake from the displayed root EV sum or transfer current custom-builder rules to this library solution.
